definitions.explanation: Black ink made from soot, used in calligraphy and painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墨|すみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摺|す}って→摺る：noentry⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: During calligraphy class, I ground ink and wrote with a brush.

notes:
{墨|すみ} is traditional East Asian ink, made from soot and used for calligraphy and painting.

TRADITIONAL USAGE:
Traditional {墨|すみ} comes in solid sticks that are ground on an inkstone (⟦{硯|すずり}→硯：06124_suzuri⟧) with water. This process is called {墨|すみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摺|す}る→摺る：noentry⟧.
